scope: Resolve whether the 1904 Bowdoin dealer form 'Nahman & Co.' can be documentary-bound to Maurice Nahman, without assuming identity from surname alone.

bowdoin.document: May 1904 consular certificate in accession file for Bowdoin 1905.25.2

details: Brooklyn Archives reports Maurice Nahman archival records there are from the 1930s-1940s.
Brooklyn Libraries reports the visitor book begins in 1918 and most Nahman papers are later.
This is a holdings/date-range negative only, not evidence against identity.
brooklyn_museum.referral: Morgan Library via ArchiveGrid Maurice Nahman search

known_records: Charles Lang Freer Papers Series 6.5.2, Box 116, Folder 4: art voucher no. 24, April 1909, to Maurice Nahman
Charles Lang Freer Papers Series 2, Box 24, Folder 28: June 3 1909 letter regarding four parcels shipped for Charles L. Freer and received by Smithsonian
Records of Freer Middle East purchases, May-August 1908, include Maurice Nahman among Cairo dealers
request_scope: earlier pre-1908 Nahman records if any

epistemic_firewall: Brooklyn's lack of 1904-1905 records does not falsify 'Nahman & Co.' = Maurice Nahman.
Later documentation of Maurice Nahman does not retroactively prove the 1904 company form.
Morgan ca. 1920 provenance is a custody lead, not target-window identity evidence.
Smithsonian 1908-1909 records are near-temporal controls; only primary wording/letterhead/signature/address evidence may promote the identity gate.
Dealer-identity evidence does not establish object-level continuity between Bowdoin, Louvre, Mendes djed, CG 53469, or any Osiris relic candidate.

next_gate.name: NAHMAN_1904_1909_BUSINESS_IDENTITY_PRIMARY_DOCUMENT_GATE
next_gate.pass_condition: Primary document sufficiently close to 1904 binds Maurice Nahman to 'Nahman & Co.' or an equivalent company form, or independently binds the same address/signature/business entity.
next_gate.negative_condition: A source-exact contradictory identity or business record separates the 1904 'Nahman & Co.' entity from Maurice Nahman.
next_gate.unresolved_condition: Only later provenance or surname-level associations are found.
